accolades.name: The Livery Pumpkin Beer Homebrew Competition

roles.title: Lead Packaging Tech/Cellarman
responsibilities: Set up, operate, and shut down the canning line for brewery packaging runs.
Coordinate the packaging crew and troubleshoot equipment issues during production runs.
Perform packaging quality checks to monitor finished beer before distribution.
Fill kegs for distribution and taproom service, supporting both wholesale and in-house beer supply.
Transfer beer between vessels and check carbonation levels ahead of packaging.
Clean fermentors and brite tanks between batches to prepare vessels for continued production.
Track inventory to support cellar and packaging operations.

roles.title: Keg Washer
responsibilities: Operated the keg washer and organized clean kegs for filling to support daily packaging operations.
Inspected kegs for condition and cleanliness before returning them to service.
Packed and stacked cans on the canning line to keep packaged beer moving through production.
Palletized packaged beer and wrapped finished pallets for storage and distribution.
Cleaned brewery floors at the end of each day to maintain an orderly production environment.

roles.title: Bar Back
responsibilities: Collected and washed taproom glassware to keep bartenders supplied throughout service.
Changed kegs and stocked the walk-in cooler to keep draft offerings available to guests.
Restocked bar supplies to keep bartenders equipped throughout service.
Cleared tables and maintained clean, welcoming taproom and outdoor seating areas.
Supported brewery events with glassware collection, restocking, and taproom upkeep.
Assisted with opening and closing duties to prepare the taproom for service and clean up afterward.

roles.title: Bartender
responsibilities: Served brewery beers, guided tastings, and recommended selections based on guests’ preferences.
Managed guest tabs and processed payments through the point-of-sale system.
Handled opening and closing duties and maintained a clean, organized taproom.
Changed kegs and restocked bar supplies to keep the taproom ready for service.
Supported brewery events while providing attentive bar service to guests.
Counted the cash drawer as part of daily taproom operations.
